name: Living Infrastructure Diagrams & Real-time Incident Dashboards

mentions.name: Living Infrastructure Diagrams & Real-time Incident Dashboards
mentions.description: This tool automatically generates living infrastructure diagrams from a team's IaC files and turns them into real-time incident dashboards. Instead of architecture diagrams being stale PNG files in Confluence, the visualization updates during outages to show exactly what's failing and how to fix it, acting as a war room during incidents. It will be available as both a web app and a native desktop app.
mentions.problem: Architecture diagrams are typically stale PNG files in Confluence rather than live resources usable as a war room during incidents.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a tool that automatically generates living infrastructure diagrams from your IaC files and turns them into real-time incident dashboards. Think Figma meets Datadog - beautiful visualization that updates during outages to show you exactly what's failing and how to fix it.
